subject: shim ion table 64 slots overflows for AV1/VP9 (fmt/patches/0002-shim-ion256.patch)
body: vpud itself holds ~34 (H.264) .. ~53 (AV1) ion buffers; each client buffer the AP publishes adds a share (2 per output buffer, dpb 16 for AV1 / 20 for VP9). In one vcodecd an AV1 session after VP9 fails: ion_import failed / 'Y framebuf get_ion_buffer_addr fail' (PC, ION256=0 fmt/run_sim_fmt.sh); with N2AND_ION_BUFS 256 it passes. The staged vc7-fmt payload is built with the patch applied to a /tmp copy; please land it (or a dynamic table).
